metadata.title: Type-II Singularities of Immersed Locally Convex Curves Evolving under Generalized Anisotropic Gage Area-Preserving Flows with Slow Curvature Speeds
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we study the singularity behavior of immersed locally convex closed plane curves evolving under generalized anisotropic Gage area-preserving flows with slow curvature speeds of the form $\kappa_\sigma^\alpha$, where $0<\alpha\le 1$. Here $\kappa_\sigma$ denotes the anisotropic curvature associated with a prescribed anisotropy function $\sigma$. We prove that every finite-time blow-up is of Type-II provided that the Euclidean length of the evolving curve remains uniformly bounded away from zero. This result holds without any symmetry assumptions on either the initial curve or the anisotropy. When the initial signed area is nonzero, this length lower bound is automatically satisfied, and thus any finite-time singularity is necessarily of Type-II. By means of Hamilton's rescaling method combined with a differential Harnack estimate, we show that along a suitable blow-up subsequence, the rescaled curves at the selected times converge locally to the profile of a translating solution of the corresponding anisotropic curvature flow $V=\kappa_\sigma^\alpha$. We also establish sufficient conditions for finite-time singularity formation in terms of the initial signed area and anisotropic length. Moreover, we construct locally convex initial curves arbitrarily close to the Wulff curve for which a finite-time Type-II singularity occurs.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 曲率流奇点与放大极限
analysis.workSummary: 研究浸入、局部凸的闭平面曲线在广义各向异性 Gage 保面积流下的奇点，曲率速度为 κσ^α，0<α≤1。若演化曲线的欧氏长度一致远离零，则任一有限时间爆破必为 II 型；初始有向面积非零时该长度条件自动成立。适当放大子列在选定时刻局部趋于相应各向异性曲率流的平移解轮廓。
techniques: 有向面积与各向异性长度控制
analysis.breakthrough: 去除了初始曲线和各向异性的对称性假设，给出有限时奇点的充分条件，并构造任意接近 Wulff 曲线却发生有限时 II 型奇点的局部凸初值。
analysis.limitations: II 型判别依赖长度正下界；放大结论是适当子列在所选时刻的局部轮廓收敛，摘要未声称整个重标度流唯一收敛。“接近 Wulff 曲线”的具体拓扑及各向异性函数条件须查正文。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。PDF 共 23 页，页数核对一致、文本完整提取且无短文本页。标准披露检索及补充的 A.I./A. I.、可断行模型名称与 AI 用语检索均未发现命中，因此本次未观察到作者自述 AI 使用披露；这不等同于确认未使用 AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 直接涉及保面积曲率流的奇点分类、Harnack 方法与平移孤子，和几何分析重点高度吻合。
